title: Spacious Home Convenient to Downtown Nashville
description:
All the convenience of Nashville, but a quaint country town...New Listing! Newly renovated home with an easy 20 min drive to downtown Nashville without all of the traffic. Home is located in a quiet, family friendly neighborhood with plenty of amenities close by. Walmart and many dining options just a few miles away. Great local parks and all the fun of the Cumberland River just minutes down the road.  Hot tub and pool table are just a few of the amenities that make this house special!

Guest access
Guests have access to all of the property with the exception of a few closets and storage areas. They have access to one closet in each of the main floor bedrooms (3). One closet in each of these rooms is kept for personal items and/or supplies.

In addition to real estate, I enjoy spending time on the Cumberland River boating and hiking the trails around Ashland City.  My favorite places to eat in Ashland City are Cody's (breakfast), Sidelines, and Don Ponchos.
